entities.summary: Nicolas "Nico" Van Kerckhoven is a former Belgian professional footballer who played as a left-back. His former clubs include Lierse, FC Schalke 04 and K.V.C. Westerlo. He represented Belgium at two World Cups in 1998 and 2002.
